scope: Only explicitly authored Mermaid radar.curveTension, with the named parameter interpreted by its pinned versioned public renderer definition. This is not a universal definition of Catmull-Rom tension, not a default palette/layout match and not a candidate/reference agreement oracle. Default0.17 is never imposed when unrequested.

sources.purpose: Names the public Catmull-Rom-to-cubic-Bezier conversion factor, bounds0..1; does not alone define its coefficient convention.
Documents rounded-curve tension as an authored rendering option.
Versioned definition of the named Mermaid public parameter: direct coefficient of neighbor differences in cubic controls, independently transcribed below.

definition.cardinalConvention: Equivalent cardinal spline tension tau=1-6*t. Generic tension conventions alone cannot establish this mapping.

independentControls.effect: All cubic controls coincide with segment endpoints; geometric locus is the straight polygon.

analyticProperties: Translation, rotation and uniform scaling preserve the mapped curve.
Adjacent cyclic cubic derivatives agree: both are3*t*(P(i+1)-P(i-1)) at vertexPi.
observationRule: Reconstruct the plot center/radius/axis rays from independently painted grid and labels; derive vertices from complete literal data/range. Compare actual visible owned cubic controls or actual curve pixels to fixed source t. Do not fit the requested t or grid anchors from the curve being graded. Unsupported path/paint/ownership remains unknown; wrong explicit coefficient must fail.
